title: llama.cpp GGUF File Parsing HunyuanVL Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of llama.cpp. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must load a malicious model file.
The specific flaw exists within the handling of HunyuanVL vision projector models. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.
addtionnal_details:
llama.cpp has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32131
